reasons.detail: Round-0 transfer item 2 (avoid, user_provided) records that this workflow's exact method — single-position sweep + anchored size-2/3 combo over the d3 mask — stalls at the 1132 local optimum, and the shipped 1120 champion required full-space simulated annealing (64-bit bit-flip spanning both d3 rounds). Re-running a known-stalling method on the same axis is a measured-prior mismatch.

The workflow's topology is parallel_fanout searching d3 and d4 in separate combo agents, but the session thesis (transfer item 1, explore) is d3×d4 SYNERGY: d3-alone -4, d4-alone -18, both -32 — a coupling only a joint co-perturbation of both masks can see. Independent fanout cannot observe the cross-mask interaction that is the entire point of this session.

kernel-profile.md names load (floor 1043.0) as the binding engine and the active lever as sparse load-floor search needing ~7 more load cycles; sweep+combo over a benefit window is a local-move heuristic, whereas the design space is a coupled 64-bit joint mask whose champion was only reached by full-space SA — the method's move set is too narrow for the search space shape.
